cases.question: If I sell my phone after a repair, does the new owner still have warranty?
cases.answer: Yes - the 90-day repair warranty travels with the device, not the original customer, so a new owner is still covered for whatever's left of the 90 days. They'll just need the original receipt [2].

cases.question: What's covered under your repair warranty?
cases.answer:
Every repair is covered by a 90-day warranty against defects in parts and workmanship. If the same issue comes back within that window, it gets fixed again at no charge.

A few things it doesn't cover: new physical damage, liquid damage that happens after the repair, or problems caused by another shop working on the device afterward. The coverage travels with the device, not the original owner, so if you sell or gift the phone the new owner is still covered for the rest of the 90 days as long as they have the original receipt.

Want me to check anything specific about your own repair?

cases.question: Does the warranty cover if I drop my phone again after the repair?
cases.answer:
No - the 90-day warranty covers defects in parts and workmanship, not new physical damage [2]. So if the phone gets dropped again after the repair, that's a new issue rather than a warranty claim.

The team would still take a look and quote any fresh repair before doing the work [4]. Want me to have someone follow up on what that would cost?

cases.question: How long does a screen repair usually take?
cases.answer: Most screen repairs are done the same day, usually within two to three hours of drop-off. If a part has to be specially ordered for a rarer model, that adds time, but the team will tell you up front if that's the case. Want me to help you book a slot?

cases.question: How long will a water damage assessment take?
cases.answer: Water damage assessments usually take three to five business days, since they need a diagnostic soak and component-level testing [2]. The team will give you a realistic estimate when you drop the device off and call you if anything changes [2].

cases.question: What happens if you need to order a part for my rarer phone model?
cases.answer:
If a part has to be specially ordered because it's a rarer model the shop doesn't stock, the team will tell you that up front rather than leave you waiting without warning, and uncommon parts can usually be in within two business days [2].

Anything else you'd like to know about the process?

cases.question: Do I need to book an appointment before coming in?
cases.answer: Nope, walk-ins are always welcome. Booking ahead online just guarantees you a same-day slot during busy times like weekends [4].

cases.question: What happens if I don't pick up my phone after it's repaired?
cases.answer:
Once a repair is finished, the team texts you so you're not left guessing. If a device sits unclaimed for more than 30 days, there's a small daily storage fee - but it's waived if you let them know in advance that you'll be delayed picking it up [2][3].

Want me to pass along a question about a specific repair?

cases.question: Can I get my device fixed after hours?
cases.answer:
The material covers after-hours pickup but not after-hours drop-off or repair. If you need to collect your device outside business hours, ask at drop-off and the team will arrange it [2].

For drop-off itself, walk-ins are welcome during business hours, and booking ahead online guarantees a same-day slot during busy periods [2][4]. Same-day turnaround usually runs two to three hours for screen and battery repairs, while water damage assessments can take three to five business days [2]. The specific opening hours aren't published anywhere I can see.

If after-hours drop-off is what you're after, I can pass that question to the team in this chat - just say the word.

cases.question: If the repair fails, do I still owe anything?
cases.answer: Nope, you'd owe nothing. If the team can't complete a repair, you don't pay anything and you get your device back exactly as it was [3].

cases.question: Can I get a refund if I change my mind after picking up my repaired phone?
cases.answer:
Yes - if you change your mind after a finished repair has been picked up, there's a full refund within 14 days, as long as the part hasn't been damaged by misuse [3]. If the repair couldn't be completed at all, you'd owe nothing and get your device back as it is [3].

Want me to help with anything else while you're here?

cases.question: Is there a fee if I cancel before you start working on my phone?

cases.answer: Every repair comes with a 90-day warranty against defects in parts and workmanship [2]. If the same issue comes back within that window, it's fixed again at no charge [2].
